items.name: Kölner Kubing 2024
items.information:
**German**
Willkommen zurück beim Zauberwürfel Wettbewerb in Köln! Zum zweiten Mal finden die Kölner Kubing statt. Seid dabei, knackt eure Rekorde, egal ob Einsteiger oder Profi – habt Spaß an diesem Turnier. Schnappt euch euren Würfel und seid Teil dieses einzigartigen Events!

**English**
Welcome back to the Rubik's Cube competition in Cologne! The Kölner Kubing is taking place for the second time. Be there, break your records, whether you are a beginner or a pro - have fun at this tournament. Grab your cube and be part of this unique event!

items.name: Fast Solves in Fendalton 2024
items.information:
Fast Solves in Fendalton 2024 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

items.name: Weston-super-Mare Spring 2024
items.information:
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**Spectators may attend for free!**

[![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/OXOffhf.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)

**PLEASE NOTE**: For this competition, there will be a competitor limit of 16 for Multi-Blind on a first come first serve basis. If you register for Multi-Blind and are not within the first 16 people registered, your registration for the event will be removed. However we will be keeping a waiting list for this specific event in the case of dropouts either before the competition or on the day. Please only consider registering for this event if you are certain you would like to compete in it.

items.name: Wendlinger Würfelwochenende 2024
items.information:
Nach über einem Jahrzehnt kehrt endlich eine Speedcubing Competition nach Wendlingen zurück. Speedcuber dürfen sich auf Spannung, Rekorde und eine leidenschaftliche Gemeinschaft freuen. 

After more than a decade, a speedcubing competition is finally returning to Wendlingen. Speedcubers can look forward to excitement, records and a passionate community.
